procedure: Walk registration, insurance and handoff steps with department owners
expected_result: Each handoff has a receiving owner and a defined exception route

procedure: Enter incomplete insurance and failed eligibility examples
expected_result: Every exception has timestamp, owner, disposition and next-action due time

procedure: Have staff explain the exception and backup-coverage procedure
expected_result: Required staff acknowledge the procedure and can identify escalation route

procedure: Run synthetic pilot cases through normal and exception paths
expected_result: No case is lost between teams; unresolved cases remain visible

procedure: Review queue aging and wait times at the same daily cutoff
expected_result: Averages and aged open exceptions are reported separately

procedure: Transfer unresolved cases and process ownership
expected_result: Operations accepts remaining exceptions with accountable owners and review dates
